findings: Calculator leak (Day-1, confirmed 14 Sep 2026): The hero quote captures name+mobile. The mid-page 'Calculate Your Savings' widget does not. A user can see list price, subsidy+discount, effective cost and a 120-month EMI without giving a phone number, then leave. In rooftop solar that is the highest-intent moment ('kitna padega?'). Gate the result: 3 fields (city, phone, monthly bill) THEN the number. Keep the hero form; stop the ungated widget from being a self-serve bounce.

WhatsApp vs 8-field form: Day-1 lists destination = WhatsApp. Live primary path is a 3-step quote (name, mobile, property, bill, email*, state, city, financing). Email is required. Contact page repeats it and adds Odisha. A click-to-WhatsApp chip exists only on /contact-us/ (9000828333 / 7032541991). 9pm TSSPDCL questions will not finish an 8-field form. Make Send WhatsApp Message the ad CTA; keep the form as a secondary capture.

0+ counters on a 21,000-customer homepage: Happy Customers / Projects Executed / MW / years / Rs. Cr saved all render 0+ (JS counters not firing). Same bug Fenice has. On a paid landing this reads as a dead brand. Hard-code 20,000+ / 150+ MW / 12 years or fix the script. The 4.7 badge is above; the zeros are below - they cancel each other.

Geo waste: Serviceable form = TS, AP, MH, MP, UP, Kerala. India-wide Meta (23 creatives est.) will pay for Bangalore / Chennai / Ahmedabad clicks that the form cannot even select. Geo-split campaigns to the 6 states + exclude the rest. Experience-centre cities (Karimnagar, Vizag, Bhopal, Nellore, Khammam, Rajahmundry, Aurangabad, Vijayawada, Tirupati, Indore) should each have a city landing, not one homepage.

Ops / review leak (this is the expensive one): 4.7 from 4,473-4,628 reviews is an asset. 235 one-stars (~5%) are a campaign. Jul 2026 Google: (a) Kerala - KSEB transformer full, site 'not feasible' AFTER 100% payment and install; (b) Anantapur - Rs.15k token 11 May, Rs.1,59,599 cash 3 Jun, material 15 Jul vs promised 10 days, incomplete install photographed as complete; (c) app hid payment history after pay-in-full. You claim 1-in-3 is referral. One-stars kill that. Feasibility with DISCOM before collecting 100% is a process fix that also becomes a trust ad ('we confirm TSSPDCL/KSEB slot before you pay').
